normalization.provenance: slab_protocol_v1.json: RMS of full-angle worm_004 development slab, frozen before this split; never recompute from reserved clean targets

model.padding: zero; no ordinary angular circular padding
model.activation: ReLU after first three convolutions; linear output

hypotheses: B improves narrow-span selection and audit over A under matched steps and populations
B versus C isolates explicit geometry channels
Seed disagreement may rank error beyond angular distance, without calibration
split_rationale: Keep the two original 12-ID validation proxy groups whole: group2 selection, group7 audit. Both have historical exposure; audit is a one-time development assessment, not pristine independent testing.

training.updates: frozen from training-only throughput in training_budget.json before any primary training
training.batch_rule: smallest batch within 95% best examples/sec, <= available VRAM minus4GiB; no duplicated samples within profile batch
training.noise_rule: 16 reproducible full100x310 fields per training slice/seed, sparse selected, cycled by completed deformation-slice pass; same order/banks across A/B/C
training.loss: per-sample missing-ray MSE (divide by number of missing detector rays), then batch mean
training.precision: FP32; no AMP needed for this tiny model
training.selection: minimum per-file mean relativeL2 across18 selection masks, pool8slices within mask, equal masks then equal files; first checkpoint wins ties

gate.primary_group: primary_narrow (new_in_distribution with13 retained angles /90 nominal acquired degrees)
gate.seed_rule: all three seed models must satisfy all three thresholds
gate.candidate: lowest seed-mean selection primary_narrow error among passing A/B/C; alphabetical tie

audit_policy: No audit TIFF read or audit outcomes until checkpoint and capacity decision plus analysis settings are frozen. Familiar masks intentionally overlap train/selection/audit; all other inventories must have disjoint actual masks. Reserved data forbidden.

capacity.rule: Only consider if B passes gate, B selection narrow error >0.35, and mean final-quarter training loss improves <1% with train/eval per-ray MSE gap <10%; otherwise skip. Any eligible architecture/budget must be frozen separately before audit.

analysis.center: missing rows circular angular distance >=3 sparse rows from closest measured row; boundary distance<=2; distance is geometric score only
analysis.ensemble: sample std ddof1 across3 independently initialized seed models; use selected passing arm only
analysis.risk: per-file pooled absolute clean missing-ray error; stable score ordering, fixed random baseline, geometry distance baseline; finite-set diagnostics not population inference
analysis.figures: fixed first audit file, first audit new_in_distribution90 mask, z256; worst file/mask by selected-model or B seed-mean relativeL2, z256. Common scales. Fourier detector transforms and FBP surrogates not voxel truth.

gaussian.conditional_new_cases: first and last selection file, first primary_narrow mask (start7.2/span90), two starts0/81 per arm
gaussian.case_rule: 2cases x3arms x2starts=12fits if preflight permits remaining1800CPU seconds; same count for all arms; stop only with explicit missing records
gaussian.selection: finite feasible numerically accepted optimizer-terminated candidates then acquired objective; if none, finite feasible lowest acquired objective marked provisional; independent-start gate still mandatory

limitations: One synthetic organism; numeric proximity is not verified genealogy.
Projection integration scaling and original deformed voxel truth absent.
Historical unseen masks informed this development and are not new holdouts.
No new posterior inference; failed phantom sampler remains paused.
